beats.text: Who's really on dating apps just for sex? Let's find out!
On OkCupid, users could tick what they're looking for. One option: casual sex.
Straight men: six point one percent!
Gay men and lesbians: almost seven percent!
And straight women? Zero point eight percent!
One in sixteen men. One in a hundred and twenty-five women! At least, that's what they were willing to tick.

sources: Christian Rudder (2014), Dataclysm (via TIME, '9 Ugly Truths'): explicitly seeking casual sex on OkCupid: 6.1% straight men, 6.9% gay men, 6.9% lesbians, 0.8% straight women.
